title: Sort
text: Sort input elements by value, 1 input, 2 outputs, no direct feedthrough, {Rounding mode} sets Method of rounding operation; {Mode} sets the whether block returns values, indices, or both Value, {Sort order} sets the order of sorting, {Sort algorithm} sets the sort method Quick, {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the method of overflow action, {Product output}, {Accumulator} and {Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools} prevents fixed-point tools from overriding data. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Idx
ports.summary: Index of the sorted data vector | matrix

params.name: Mode
params.values: Specify whether block returns values, indices, or both Value and Index (default) | Value | Index

params.name: Sort algorithm
params.values: Sort method Quick sort (default) | Insertion sort

params.name: Rounding mode
params.values: Method of rounding operation Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: Method of overflow action off (default) | on

params.name: Product output
params.values: Product output data type Inherit: Same as input (default) | fixdt([],16,0)

params.name: Accumulator
params.values: Accumulator data type Inherit: Same as product output (default) | Inherit: Same as input | fixdt([],16,0)

params.name: Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools
params.values: Prevent fixed-point tools from overriding data types off (default) | on
